facts.fact: IOM's county functionality assessment of eleven locations (ten counties and Wau Municipality), carried out September to December 2021, found one Commissioner's office with a satellite terminal (VSAT): Maban, which has two VSATs, one for the Office of the Commissioner and one for the Health Department; the report's own recommendations section omits Maban and says only Renk and Rubkona have any.
facts.system: VSAT at the County Commissioner's office

facts.fact: IOM's assessment of eleven locations in late 2021 found ten with no VSAT at the Commissioner's or Mayor's office: in Renk and Rubkona the sole VSAT is the Health Department's and the Commissioner's office and all other departments have none, and Baliet, Fashoda, Leer, Pariang, Pibor, Raja, Wau County and Wau Municipality report no VSAT and a need for one across all departments.
facts.system: VSAT at the County Commissioner's office

facts.fact: IOM reports that of eleven local governments assessed in late 2021 (ten of the country's counties and Wau Municipality), one, Maban, has a VSAT at the Commissioner's office and ten have none; in two of the ten, Renk and Rubkona, the only VSAT belongs to the county health department.
facts.system: VSAT at the County Commissioner's office

facts.fact: IOM's late-2021 assessment states that the Maban Commissioner's office has a VSAT and names no use made of it.
